title: Update Formspree registration endpoint
body:
The registration form was still posting to the deprecated Formspree endpoint. This updates the live submission target and removes the remaining stale Formspree reference in the repository.

- **Form submission**
  - Updated the registration form in `index.html` to post to the new Formspree endpoint.

- **Repository consistency**
  - Replaced the old Formspree URL in `README.md` so documentation matches the live form configuration.
  - Confirmed there are no remaining references to the old endpoint, including in `thank-you.html`.

```html
<form action="https://formspree.io/f/mbgljzwr" method="POST" id="regForm">
```
